source.label: Bundled directional hardware catalog with official NVIDIA specifications
source.methodology: Legacy entries retain representative planning inputs. Added NVIDIA entries use official vendor specifications and vendor list or Marketplace reference prices; ThinkCentre X Tower qualification statuses come from a user-provided pre-release Lenovo option snapshot. supportedCounts describes physically offered card counts, while supportsTensorParallel separately controls whether one model may pool their memory. Prices vary by region and date. No LLM throughput is inferred from AI TOPS or other board specifications.
